rationale: The inspected study reports that the modern networks evaluated were poorly calibrated and presents empirical temperature-scaling results across its evaluated architectures and datasets. The claim properly confines both observations to the paper's studied settings.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-004-R2 — PDF pp. 2–3, calibration and temperature-scaling experiments
limitations: The experiments concern selected classification datasets and architectures.
Calibration on a held-out distribution does not show calibrated uncertainty under operational shift, correlated sensor faults or closed-loop control effects.
